exposure: Anomaly scan findings in prenatal ultrasound
outcome: Histopathological diagnosis of Hirschsprung disease (HD) after birth
Other structural anomalies (ventriculoseptal defect, atriseptal defect, atrio-ventricular septal defect, pyloric stenosis)
cohort: The study included 22 children who received a histopathological diagnosis of Hirschsprung disease between 1 day and 15 months of age, born between 1990 and 2008.
finding: Abnormal sonographic findings of fetal bowel are absent in the vast majority of fetuses who are diagnosed with Hirschsprung disease after birth.
followup_time: Up to 15 months after birth (for HD diagnosis)
